did: Finished hear-again: the owner can ask home to hear any judged take again, at most once per take every six hours. Built it to your two answers: while home hears it again the old words stay, marked being heard again, and if the fresh try fails the old words stay. A request now only replaces the transcriptions it found, once the fresh one ends, which was the mechanism four review rounds kept tripping on. An essay refused for takes that ran out of tries waits once you ask again, its takes go first in the line, and a fast-track on them works. Both halves merged as a pair, some-ui first because it carries the new table's ledger store.

calls.title: When a request to hear a take again replaces the old words (C1040)
options: Only once its fresh transcription ends, and only the transcriptions that existed when you asked
From the moment you ask, hiding the old words while home hears it
Every transcription but the fresh one while the request stands
calls.why: It is the agreed shape and matches your answers: the old words stay while home hears it, and stay if every fresh try fails; a later model's words are never hidden by an older request
calls.undo: A migration dropping the supersedes table and view; readers go back to the newest ending

calls.title: A fresh hearing counts as a new key for a fast-track mark (C1041)
options: Yes: a marked take no model heard gets one more try at the head of the line under the fresh key
No: a mark is spent once tried under any key
calls.why: A new model's key already works this way, the line's order rule stays per key, and the six-hour snooze caps it
calls.undo: Make a mark also require no try under any key

calls.title: While a take is heard again, essays wait and the mailbox files the old words (C1042)
options: Essays wait for the fresh words; the mailbox files what stands now
calls.why: The essay needs the fresh words; the mailbox can't tell a live request from a moot one without home's keys, and files the fresh ones once heard
calls.undo: Drop the wait in the essays' take hand-off

calls.title: A home with no transcriber refuses a hear-again request (C1043)
options: Refuse it, and read no take as being heard again
Take it and let it wait until the transcriber runs
calls.why: Otherwise a take reads being heard again for as long as the transcriber is off
calls.undo: Pass the keys whether or not the transcriber runs

left: A take's link back to its script's scene isn't built; spoken cards and interview questions link back. Filed as some-ui#3402.
A take's search vector can outlive superseded words if the meaning model is off when its ending changes. Not home's setup today; filed as server#1105.
A blank take saved before verdicts has no verdict to answer, so it can't be heard again and its week still waits; noted in the ledger's VH4.
The phone's replaces= carrier for a take recorded again (#920) wasn't in this design and is left for later.
